commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' 2 - 1 Goal! Toni Martinez (Alaves) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
90+2' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) dribbles his way into the box and has an effort on goal, but the ball flies way over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' Angel Perez (Alaves) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
90' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header well wide of the right post. What a poor effort.
89' Alaves have a corner.
89' Angel Perez (Alaves) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Alaves.
86' Alaves have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

85' Carles Alena (Alaves) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The linesman points to the corner flag, Alaves are going to take it.
83' None of the Alaves players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
83' Victor Parada (Alaves) latches on to a superb cross into the box and hits the left post with a fine header. What a chance! The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
82' The resulting set piece from Alaves is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

81' Angel Perez (Alaves) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. The ball goes behind for a corner. Alaves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
80' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
77' Toni Martinez (Alaves) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the right-hand post, but Andriy Lunin was alert and the score remains the same.
77' The attendance for today's match is 61468.
75' The game has come to an end for Antonio Blanco. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Ander Guevara (Alaves).
74' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is caught offside!
72' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) collects an inch-perfect pass and strikes the ball from far out, but his shot is blocked.
68' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
68' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) takes the corner with a short pass.
68' Real Madrid get a corner.
66' Substitution. Ibrahim Diabate (Alaves) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Lucas Boye walks off.
66' Substitution. Yusi did his best and is replaced by Calebe (Alaves).
63' We are about to witness a subsitution. Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) for Trent Alexander-Arnold.
63' Here is a change. Aurelien Tchouameni is going off and Alvaro Arbeloa gives the last tactical orders to Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid).
63' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
62' Real Madrid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
62' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. Real Madrid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
62' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Antonio Sivera anticipates well and smothers the ball.
61' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Alaves was in an offside position.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jon Guridi leaves the pitch and Carles Alena (Alaves) comes on.
58' It's time for a substitution. Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) comes on in place of Denis Suarez.
58' It will be a substitution. Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) is ready to enter the pitch as Jude Bellingham walks off.
58' Alvaro Arbeloa has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) replacing Arda Guler.
55' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) jumps into a tackle and Juan Martinez signals a foul.

50' 2 - 0 Federico Valverde passes to Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid), who collects the ball and unleashes a terrific shot from the edge of the box. His effort goes into the bottom left corner. Fabulous goal! The score is 2:0.

49' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) covers his face with his hands after spurning a great chance. The ball rebounded to him but his close-range header went a whisker over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
49' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a low header towards middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper shows his reflexes to stop the effort.
48' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

48' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The ball is out of play and Real Madrid manage to earn a corner.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+7' Juan Martinez blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+7' The corner is swung in but Alaves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

45+6' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) received a pass and didn't think long what to do with it. He fired a powerful long-range shot which went painfully close to the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.

45+5' What an opportunity! Toni Martinez (Alaves) wastes a huge chance as he latches on to a perfect pass and produces a first-time blast from point blank range. It goes towards the bottom left corner, but Andriy Lunin reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
45+5' Toni Martinez (Alaves) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies onto the left post!
45+3' Real Madrid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45+2' Eder Militao is substituted due to injury. Alvaro Arbeloa gives a chance to Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid).
45+2' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Federico Valverde (Real Madrid). Real Madrid earn a corner.
45+1' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) blows a clear opportunity to score as he rattles the crossbar from point-blank range. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
44' The corner from Arda Guler (Real Madrid) is cleared away by the defence.
42' Vinicius Junior provides the assist in the box, but Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) places his shot a fraction wide of the right post.
42' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
38' 9:4 – the total goal attempt statistics.
35' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
34' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) latches on to an accurate pass into the box and immediately unleashes a low shot goalwards. His effort is well saved by the keeper.

32' That's unlucky! Trent Alexander-Arnold (Real Madrid) side steps a tackle after receiving a pass, advances then hits a booming shot from mid-range which only rises at the last second to fly just over the bar.
32' A pass into the box finds Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the roof of the net, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Antonio Sivera denies him.
30' 1 - 0 Goal! Arda Guler passes the ball to Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) and he fires in a shot from the edge of the box which is deflected. Antonio Sivera couldn't do anything about it. 1:0.
30' Angel Perez (Alaves) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Andriy Lunin intercepts the ball.
28' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

28' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Real Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
27' Antonio Sivera (Alaves) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
27' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) is able to continue to play.
25' Antonio Sivera (Alaves) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
25' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
24' Real Madrid quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

24' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) decides to have a go at goal from the edge of the box, but the wall jumps as one and blocks the free kick. Danger averted! The ball is out of play. Real Madrid win a corner kick.
22' Juan Martinez blows his whistle after Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Real Madrid are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
21' Toni Martinez (Alaves) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
19' Toni Martinez (Alaves) picks up an injury.
17' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Alaves.
16' Angel Perez (Alaves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Corner kick. Alaves will have an opportunity.
16' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
14' Juan Martinez interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Eder Militao (Real Madrid).
11' Angel Perez (Alaves) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
10' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
9' Toni Martinez (Alaves) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Andriy Lunin is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
8' A clever short pass gives Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) a clear goal scoring opportunity, but he fluffs his lines and rifles the ball high over the bar.
8' A quickly taken corner by Real Madrid.

8' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) goes on a mazy run and tries his luck with a mid-range strike, but one of the defending players steps in and makes a block. The ball goes out of play. Real Madrid are awarded a corner kick.
6' Aurelien Tchouameni (Real Madrid) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
4' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
3' Lucas Boye (Alaves) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
